Subject: Capacity mapping & proposed commit for Optimed (OP-5893)

Hi Alice / Tom,

Following our usage audit for Q1–Q2, I pulled together a short capacity mapping and a proposed amendment to bridge your burst needs into committed capacity. Key highlights from the snapshot (attached):

- Sustained average GPU utilization (all clusters): ~68% over 24h
- Peak window (09:00–15:00 PT): spikes to 92% for ~6 hours/day
- Off-peak (night/weekends): utilization backs down to ~40%
- P95 latency and queueing incidents align with peak periods and burst throttling

Attachment: [Optimed-utilization-snapshot-2027Q1.csv (CSV, ~120KB)]

Initial recommendation: convert 80 GPUs to a committed tranche (steady baseline) and reserve an 16-GPU burst pool for short peaks. That combination reduces per-token cost by ~22% vs fully burst usage while keeping average latency within SLA. I also noted autoscaling policy is set to conservative cooldowns — we should discuss shortening cooldowns to better absorb rapid bursts.

Can we schedule a 30-min call this week to walk through the data and the amendment language? Proposed times: Wed 6/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 6/24 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Optimed's quick reply (see below). They asked for run-rate comparisons and rationale for 80 vs their current 56 commit. I pulled the utilization bands into a short recommendation and a pricing ask (attached draft amendment):

Summary (from usage snapshot):
- Baseline CPU/GPU interplay: stable baseline demand aligns with daytime inference workloads tied to user queries (predictable)
- Recommended commit: 80 GPUs (converts the bulk of recurring load into committed capacity)
- Burst reserve: 16 GPUs (to absorb short peaks; estimated <30m bursts typical)
- Autoscaler tweak: reduce cooldown from 5m -> 90s for inference pool to reduce queue buildup

Impact:
- Estimated monthly cost (approx):
  - Option A (56C + 40B): $131k
  - Option B (80C + 16B): $103k (committed discount applied)
  - Delta: ~21% savings expected in steady-state months

Ask: can we offer a one-quarter expansion credit (10% off committed capacity fees for the next 3 months) to help Optimed transition, and do we have green light on 80C + 16B pricing? If yes, I'll send a redline-ready amendment and schedule the call Wed 10:00 PT.

Attachment: [proposed-amendment-OP-5893.pdf] — internal draft for pricing and SLA changes.

Notes: include a short bullet in the amendment about rollback rights if sustained utilization drops below 55% over a rolling 30-day period.

-M
